README: Typed scenes fed to the agent by scripts/run_samples.py. These are INPUTS ONLY -- no expected answers live here, because the point of the gallery is to show what the pipeline actually returns, not to check it against a wish list. Tests are where expectations belong. Chosen for spread across the five axes rather than for laughs: two of these (the funeral, the hospital) exist to show the taboo rules and the confidence floor doing their jobs.

scenes.text: a funeral service in a church, mourners dressed in black
scenes.why_this_one: the clearest test of the taboo rules -- the mood inverts to euphoric, and the rules have to stop it landing somewhere indefensible

scenes.text: a first date at a candlelit restaurant, two people talking quietly
scenes.why_this_one: warm, low-arousal, intimate. The opposite of intimate is public, and that is a different axis from loud

scenes.text: a hospital waiting room at 3am under fluorescent lights
scenes.why_this_one: low valence AND low arousal at once, which most scenes never are

scenes.text: a toddler's birthday party, cake being cut, children shouting
scenes.why_this_one: the specificity case from AGENTS.md -- 'indoor event' produces nothing, this produces a joke

scenes.text: a packed nightclub at 1am, strobe lights and bass
scenes.why_this_one: the top corner of arousal and density. Inversion has nowhere to go but down, and down is not automatically funny

scenes.text: a silent university library reading room during exam week
scenes.why_this_one: the scene the live model already read from real footage, typed instead -- the two runs can be compared

scenes.text: a beach at sunset, warm light and slow waves
scenes.why_this_one: high valence, high organicness, low density -- the corner the corpus is thinnest in

scenes.text: a crowded subway train on a weekday morning commute
scenes.why_this_one: dense and artificial but emotionally flat, so density has to carry the inversion on its own

scenes.text: a yoga class in a warm studio, mats on the floor, slow breathing
scenes.why_this_one: the most deliberately curated soundtrack in real life, which makes the wrong answer land hardest

scenes.text: a job interview in a glass meeting room, two people across a table
scenes.why_this_one: formal and tense -- the pair of traits that invert in opposite directions

scenes.text: a snowy street in December, lights strung between the buildings
scenes.why_this_one: the seasonal rule fires here and only here

scenes.text: a gym at six in the morning, someone deadlifting alone
scenes.why_this_one: high arousal with low social density, which pulls two strategies in different directions
